title.value: Disaster Tweets Classification using BERT-Based Language Model
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper's abstract.
title.quote: Disaster Tweets Classification using BERT-Based Language Model

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development of a machine learning language model using BERT to classify tweets as indicating 'Disaster' or 'Not Disaster'. The aim is to aid disaster relief organizations by automating the detection of emergencies based on Twitter data. The model addresses challenges associated with processing social media text, including data cleansing and hyperparameter optimization.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The focus is on leveraging technology to assist in emergency response, which is crucial for sustainable development as it relates to disaster relief efforts.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The aim of this study is to create a machine learning language model that is able to investigate if a person or area was in danger or not... Design a language model that is able to understand and acknowledge when a disaster is happening based on the social network posts.
